gbm_population_evidence.quote: Anti-Glomerular Basement Membrane Disease; Anti-Glomerular Basement Membrane Antibody Disease; Goodpasture Syndrome; Good Pasture Syndrome
A Study With Imlifidase in Anti-GBM Disease

candidate_evidence.quote: Imlifidase is an immunoglobulin G (IgG)-degrading enzyme of Streptococcus pyogenes that is highly selective towards IgG.
evaluating renal function in patients with severe anti-GBM disease comparing imlifidase and standard of care (SoC) with SoC alone

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of anti-GBM disease more than 14 days prior to randomisation

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Cmax = Maximum observed plasma concentration of imlifidase following dosing.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: PD of imlifidase will be assessed as IgG levels in serum.

role_evidence.quote: Imlifidase is administered IV as one dose of 0.50 mg/kg over 30 minutes.

agents.drug_class_hint: IgG-degrading cysteine protease (immunosuppressive enzyme); not an antitumour agent

role_evidence.quote: SoC consists of a combination of plasma exchange (PLEX), cyclophosphamide (CYC), and glucocorticoids.
SoC consists of a combination of plasma exchange (PLEX), cyclophosphamide (CYC), and glucocorticoids.

coder_notes: Trial is in anti-glomerular basement membrane (Goodpasture) disease, not glioblastoma; excluded at S5 (anti_gbm_disease). Imlifidase is the investigational agent of the experimental arm (role per rule 4) but it is not an antitumour agent, so has_eligible_candidate is false. Specific glucocorticoid not named; 'glucocorticoids' used as placeholder moiety. Serum IgG PD outcomes exist but are not tumour target engagement. No tumour biomarkers.
